import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_constraint_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
  have h₁ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 14 ≤ 0 := by linarith
  have h₂ : (x - 5 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 81 / 4 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2)]
  have h₃ : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 5 / 2)]
  exact h₃

theorem quadratic_constraint_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
  have h₁ : -9 / 2 ≤ x - 5 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 2), sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
    <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try nlinarith) <;>
    (try
      {
        cases' le_total 0 (x - 5 / 2) with h h <;>
        cases' le_total 0 (x + 2) with h₁ h₁ <;>
        cases' le_total 0 (x - 7) with h₂ h₂ <;>
        nlinarith
      }) <;>
    nlinarith
  
  have h₂ : x - 5 / 2 ≤ 9 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + 2), sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
    <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try nlinarith) <;>
    (try
      {
        cases' le_total 0 (x - 5 / 2) with h h <;>
        cases' le_total 0 (x + 2) with h₁ h₁ <;>
        cases' le_total 0 (x - 7) with h₂ h₂ <;>
        nlinarith
      }) <;>

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_constraint_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
  have h_lower : (-2 : ℝ) ≤ x := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 2)]
  have h_upper : x ≤ (7 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_constraint_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
  have hx_upper : x ≤ 7 := by
    by_contra h
    have hx : 7 < x := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hprod : 0 < (x + 2) * (x - 7) := by
      apply mul_pos
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hx_lower : -2 ≤ x := by
    by_contra h
    have hx : x < -2 := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hprod : 0 < (x + 2) * (x - 7) := by
      apply mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> nlinarith

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_constraint_centered_bound (x : ℝ) (h₀ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≤ 10) : |x - 5 / 2| ≤ 9 / 2 := by
  have hsq : (x - 5 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (9 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [h₀]
  apply (abs_le).2
  constructor
  · nlinarith [hsq, sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2 + 9 / 2)]
  · nlinarith [hsq, sq_nonneg (x - 5 / 2 - 9 / 2)]
